---
title: "Short workshops on demand"
subtitle: "Add-ons to the three courses"
---

Short workshops (one to two days) on topics that come up repeatedly in consultation. They run when there is demand. Suggestions are welcome.

| Workshop | Builds on | In short |
|---|---|---|
| [Bayesian modelling with brms](bayesian-modelling.qmd) | Linear Models in R | Bayesian versions of the models from the core course, in familiar `lme4` syntax |
| [Power analysis by simulation](power-simulation.qmd) | Linear Models in R | Plan sample sizes for designs where formulas fail, e.g. GLMMs |
| [Advanced GLMMs with glmmTMB](advanced-glmms.qmd) | Linear Models in R, session 11 | Zero-inflated, negative binomial, beta and other models beyond `glmer()` |
